item.title: Scaling Laws for Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning
item.description: We study how retrieval augmentation interacts with model scale across a family of transformer architectures, and find a consistent power-law relationship between corpus size and downstream reasoning accuracy.
item.author: Amira Haddad, Wei Zhang

item.title: Efficient Long-Context Attention Without Approximation
item.description: We present an exact attention mechanism whose memory footprint grows sublinearly in sequence length, enabling million-token contexts on commodity hardware.
item.author: Lucas Moreau
